test_cases.name: live_resource_group
test_cases.input: Diagram the Azure infrastructure in resource group rg-prod-eus in subscription Contoso-Prod.
assertions: Runs collect_rg.sh or an equivalent Resource Graph query against rg-prod-eus
Does not deploy or modify Azure resources
Runs build_diagram.py and returns Mermaid plus diagram.drawio
Summarizes network, compute, and data resources and lists unlinked resources separately

test_cases.name: export_json
test_cases.input: Here is an az graph export of rg-app. Build an infrastructure diagram from this JSON.
assertions: Skips az login and uses the supplied JSON as build_diagram.py input
Expands nested VNet subnets when they are not separate rows
Edges only connect resource IDs present in the export
Writes inventory.md with relationship labels from property names

test_cases.name: empty_and_oversize
test_cases.input: Map every resource in subscription 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000 as an architecture diagram.
assertions: Does not draw every NIC on one subscription canvas by default
Produces one diagram per resource group or a resource-group overview if the user insists on subscription scope
Pages Resource Graph when skip_token is present
Splits a resource group diagram when it exceeds 80 resources
